title: grid: a row that opens nothing (navigation mode none, or a list-only object) still draws a link-styled first cell and a right-click "Open" item that do nothing
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nWoa1Ze1QzjRTSYXD

Filing gate: ① a user-visible dead affordance with a named producer, reported by the #33219 dev (PR #33305, Acceptance notes "What still looks clickable"), read on the code by the seat.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid`). Grade p3, self-graded by the seat under the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」: nothing breaks, the click is a no-op; reach grows when #33305 lands (every list-only object's rows resolve to mode `none`).
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open "navigation" "none" grid open` 7 hits and `is:issue is:open plugin-grid "context menu" open` 3 hits, none on this.

## 维护者速读

列表里的行如果点了不会打开任何东西（视图写了 `navigation.mode: 'none'`，或 #33305 之后只开放 `list` 的对象），表格仍把第一列画成链接样式（`role="link"`），右键菜单仍有「打开」项。点了都没反应，用户会以为坏了。

## Producer

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridLinkCell.tsx` (the `role="link"` span, around line 188): drawn whenever the host passes `onRowClick`, without asking whether anything opens.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowContextMenu.tsx` (`onOpen` ⇒ the `row-context-open` item, line 70): same condition.
- The console host (`ui/packages/app-shell`) still passes `onRowClick` for mode `none` rows, because the row click handler is also how it routes other things; the grid has no signal that the open is a no-op.

## Acceptance

1. A row whose record navigation resolves to `none` (authored, or a list-only object per `servesRecordRead`) draws its first cell as plain text, not `role="link"`, and its right-click menu has no Open / Open in new tab items; row actions (`list_item`) stay.
2. A test pins both faces for mode `none` and a CONTROL with a navigable row keeping the link and the Open item.
3. No change for rows that do open (drawer, page, new tab).
